description: Source file for the main application component of a Next.js frontend. It manages user interactions for uploading documents, orchestrating persona generation, viewing version history, and editing persona details, with extensive UI state management and backend API integration.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts various input data into an array of strings, with validation and fallback handling.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Serializes JavaScript objects to JSON strings safely, catching errors and avoiding exceptions.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a readable error message from an Error object or string.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if the given value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: inferDraftFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Creates a draft persona object from an orchestration record.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Transforms backend JSON data into the application's persona data structure.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file selection by the user for document upload.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds new files to the current upload list, validating format and size.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped via drag and drop for upload.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default drag over behavior to allow drop handling.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file from the upload list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates persona draft generation via API.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves edits to the persona data.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona, saving changes and marking it as complete.

methods.name: refreshVersions
methods.description: Fetches the list of persona versions from backend.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona's skill list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles profile image uploads/changes for the persona.
